description:
The purpose of this sources sought Request for Information (RFI) is to identify vendors capable of providing commercial internet service at Basa AB, Floridablanca, Philippines. This notice is a request for vendor's capabilities, and does not serve as a solicitation.

Interested parties should respond with the following information:

- Company Name
- Mobilization or shipping time required to provide service
- Maximum and minimum internet speeds available
- General overview of how internet service will be provided (wired, wireless, satellite, etc.)
- If your company has worked on Basa AB or other APF installations previously
- Any other information that would be beneficial to us in determining available internet optionsv

NOTE: This is a Request for Information (RFI) for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation. The Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this RFI or to otherwise pay for the information solicited.
